CustomField.description: How the approver identity is resolved at runtime. Configured = resolved from ApproverType__c and ApproverValue__c. Dynamic = resolved by an Apex class implementing IApproverResolver. UserInput = user selects the approver at the time of the action.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Configured requires ApproverType__c and ApproverValue__c. Dynamic requires ApproverResolverClass__c. UserInput does not require any additional field.
CustomField.label: Approver Source
